name: Walking Thundercloud kit
description: Build scattered cloud tufts and silver rain on a clear umbrella. Add your own black clothes and shoes.

owned.note: Use a black long-sleeve top and black trousers or leggings you already own.

ownedExtras: Comfortable dark shoes you already own
extraSupplies: White scrap fabric for a removable cloud backing; supply your own, cost excluded
Sewing thread for attachment and hems; supply your own, cost excluded
Hook-and-loop tabs for the removable backing; supply your own, cost excluded
Hot-glue sticks for attaching fiberfill to the fabric backing; supply your own, cost excluded

steps: Estimate: allow about 120 minutes after every item arrives. This build has not been timed.
Fit white scrap fabric over the open umbrella and cut a center slit so the backing can lift off.
Attach hook-and-loop tabs to the backing corners and around the umbrella ribs; keep the opening mechanism clear.
Remove the backing and glue small fiberfill tufts onto it. One 12-ounce bag gives scattered coverage, not a solid cloud.
Cut the silver yard into narrow rain strips. Turn and stitch the edges with a fine needle and lightweight thread.
Tie strips to the outer ribs, away from the face. Trim every strip above the knees.
Replace the dry cloud backing and pin the small lightning bolt to your black top.
Walk and turn with the open umbrella. Remove the backing before closing it. This is a costume prop, not tested rainwear.

notes: Catalog purchase subtotal: $47.43 USD before shipping, tax, and separately supplied craft materials.
This plan assumes you own the listed clothes, shoes, tools, and extra supplies. Missing supplies add cost and shopping time.
The umbrella, stuffing, silver yard, and pin come from four merchants. No event-date delivery is confirmed.
Primary product pages were reviewed November 5, 2026, Pacific time. Exact variant stock could not be refreshed; catalog timestamps remain unchanged.
Good's Store permits online-order pickup in East Earl, Pennsylvania. This is not a confirmed local pickup plan for this kit.
The pin measures only 3/4 by 1/2 inch. No lights or large lightning prop are included.

evidence.note: Primary page lists $25 USD, White as a color option, and a transparent 52-inch canopy. White variant selection and stock were not freshly verified.
Primary page shows $8.49 and 12-ounce/32-ounce options. Polyester fiberfill is described for cloud scenes. The catalog selects one 12-ounce bag.
Primary page shows Silver at $4.99 per yard, 44/45 inches wide. This is lightweight, sheer metallic fabric, not pre-cut rain strips.
Primary page lists $8.95 per pin, Silver as a finish, free polybag packaging, and a 3/4 by 1/2 inch bolt with clutch back.
Merchant shipping policy supplies no product-specific absolute arrival date for this umbrella. Product page calculates shipping at checkout.

Merchant states dispatch within 1-3 business days and delivery estimates at checkout. Lower-48 standard shipping is $7.99 for orders through $20; shipping is excluded from the subtotal. East Earl pickup requires a separate location decision.
Merchant estimates 1-3 business days preparation and 5-7 business days standard transit, with variation. These estimates do not establish arrival for an event.
Merchant allows up to three days to process orders and does not guarantee same-day or next-day dispatch, even with overnight shipping.
Merchant recommends a fine sharp needle, lightweight thread, gentle handling, and a scrap test when sewing this delicate fabric. Kit build time is an editorial estimate.

Original creator demonstrates a removable fabric umbrella backing, hook-and-loop attachment, glued Poly-Fil tufts, and hanging rain. This kit adapts that method to scattered tufts and silver strips; it is not a tested copy of that build.

rationale: Keep the cloud frame, tufts, rain, and lightning silhouette. Reuse black separates instead of purchasing a unitard. The cheapest catalog pin keeps the listed purchases under $50; four separate shipping charges remain possible.

name: Venus Flytrap kit
description: Cut a soft green plant collar with an orange mouth and white teeth. Wear it over your own black clothes.

owned.note: Use a black top and black trousers or leggings you already own.
Use comfortable dark shoes or ankle boots you already own.

extraSupplies: Sewing thread or embroidery floss; supply your own, cost excluded
Two safety pins to attach the collar to your top; supply your own, cost excluded
Scrap paper for a shoulder-size template; supply your own, cost excluded

steps: Estimate: allow about 120 minutes after all felt arrives. This build has not been timed.
Make a paper template for an open shoulder collar and two leaves. Fit it before cutting felt.
Lay every green shape within the approximately 18 by 36 inch half-yard cut. Keep the face and neck opening clear.
Cut the green collar and leaves. Cut an orange mouth patch that fits on the front of the collar.
Cut small triangular teeth from the 9 by 12 inch white sheet.
Stitch the mouth patch and teeth onto the collar. Stitch the leaves to the collar shoulders.
Pin the collar to the shoulders of your black top. Close pin clasps and check arm movement.
Wear your own black trousers and dark shoes. This makes a soft collar, not a rigid headpiece or full plant suit.

notes: Catalog purchase subtotal: $13.50 USD before shipping, tax, and separately supplied thread and fasteners.
This plan assumes you own the listed clothes, shoes, tools, and extra supplies. Missing supplies add cost and shopping time.
All three felt purchases use Benzie Design. No event-date delivery or local pickup is confirmed.
Choose one 1/2-yard Sage cut, one 1/2-yard Pumpkin cut, and one 9 by 12 inch White sheet. Smaller felt options are not equivalent.
Primary pages were reviewed November 5, 2026, Pacific time. Exact variant price and stock refresh was blocked; $6, $6, and $1.50 remain catalog prices checked October 27.
Sage is muted green, Pumpkin is burnt orange, and wool-blend White is soft white. The result differs from bright acrylic felt.
The small felt quantities support the described collar and leaves. A larger headpiece or full-body plant needs more material.

evidence.note: Primary page offers Sage in 1/2-yard cuts on approximately 36-inch bolts. Selected catalog variant 1330487300 costs $6, checked October 27; exact variant price and stock were not freshly verified.

Primary page offers Pumpkin in 1/2-yard cuts. Selected catalog variant 1328706564 costs $6, checked October 27; the default $2.50 page price belongs to a different size. Exact variant stock was not freshly verified.

Primary page offers 9 by 12 inch White felt and explains that natural wool content produces soft white. Catalog variant 1331231668 costs $1.50, checked October 27. Exact variant stock was not freshly verified.

Merchant says most orders dispatch within 24 hours, six days weekly; large orders, holidays, and custom work can add 1-2 days. Carrier transit remains separate. International delivery can take 1-6 weeks. No absolute arrival date is established.

Merchant tutorial demonstrates cutting Sage felt leaves, attaching felt details, and adding soft felt teeth. It supports the craft techniques, not this collar pattern or its estimated 120-minute build time.

rationale: Buy the three defining felt colors from one merchant and reuse the black base and footwear. Half-yard wool-blend cuts cost less than the catalog acrylic yards, but produce a smaller, muted soft collar rather than a sculpted headpiece.
